input.quote: (a) At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding, either party may terminate this Agreement for any or no reason upon fifteen (15) days advance notice to the other.
input.rationale: The Agreement runs indefinitely until terminated under Paragraph 6 (p0011), and the only convenience right in Section 6(a) is available solely "At any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding." We therefore have no right to exit an active engagement without cause, and no prepaid-fee refund mechanic; the remainder of Section 6 is cause-based only and Section 3 contains no early-termination fee. This fails both the preferred and the fallback Customer-side elements, so we add a Company-only convenience right on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. Contractor's side already conforms: its convenience right cannot be exercised while a Statement of Work is outstanding, so it cannot walk away from committed work (we note that the 15-day notice in the no-SOW shell period is shorter than our preferred 90 days, which we flag but do not redline).

proposal.summary: Add a Company-only convenience termination right on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6(a) only lets us walk when no Statement of Work is outstanding, so we have no convenience right during an active engagement. We add a Company-only right to terminate the Agreement or any Statement of Work on 30 days' notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees; Contractor remains barred from convenience termination while a Statement of Work is outstanding. We can discuss 60-90 days' notice as a fallback.

ops.text: In addition, Company may terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work for convenience upon thirty (30) days' advance written notice to Contractor, in which case Contractor shall refund to Company, pro rata, any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of such termination.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.
